title: A quiet morning walk
preview: I noticed the way the light moved through the leaves today. There was a small bird I had never seen before — a tiny moment of wonder before the day got loud.
body:
I noticed the way the light moved through the leaves today. There was a small bird I had never seen before — a tiny moment of wonder before the day got loud.

I am trying to do this more often: notice the small things before the noise of doing arrives. The walks help. The journal helps. Even the quiet ten minutes after, where I do nothing in particular, helps.

title: A hard conversation, but honest
preview: Talked with my sister about how I have been feeling lately. It was uncomfortable to admit but afterwards I felt lighter. We do not talk enough about the small heavy things.
body:
Talked with my sister about how I have been feeling lately. It was uncomfortable to admit but afterwards I felt lighter.

We do not talk enough about the small heavy things. I forget how much honesty actually helps until I practice it.

title: Tired but okay
preview: A long day at work that ended in nothing dramatic. I am learning that "okay" is a perfectly acceptable mood. Not every entry needs an epiphany.
body: A long day at work that ended in nothing dramatic. I am learning that "okay" is a perfectly acceptable mood. Not every entry needs an epiphany.

title: Cold and a little lonely
preview: The apartment felt too quiet. I am noticing I do better when I plan one small social thing each week.
body: The apartment felt too quiet. I am noticing I do better when I plan one small social thing each week. Tomorrow I'll text Maya and ask if she wants to grab coffee.

title: Therapy session — something clicked
preview: We talked about the way I tend to apologize before stating what I actually want. Naming it out loud felt enormous.
body: We talked about the way I tend to apologize before stating what I actually want. Naming it out loud felt enormous. I have homework: practice asking for one thing this week, plainly, without the cushion.
